title: Pro Shop Store Credit: closure-settlement percentage application rule
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers how the applicable percentage from the closure-settlement threshold is actually applied to the account, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
Whichever percentage the closure-settlement threshold selects -- the tier's own refund percentage, or one hundred less the tier's own forfeiture percentage, according to which branch applies -- is applied once to the sum still standing on the account at closure. It is never applied twice, and the two percentages are never combined or stacked; exactly one of the two governs a given closure, chosen by the threshold described elsewhere.
